greet.text: Captain of the watch. If you're here to cause trouble, don't. If you're here to stop it - I could use you.

options.text: Can you teach me to use a shield?

news.text: Zombies by the dozen, skeletons picking off travellers. Something is stirring them up.

teach.text: Shield up, feet planted, let the blow slide off. Practice costs coin, mind you - steel isn't free.

raiders.text: Scouts found tracks leading to a raider outpost under a grey banner. They're behind this - I'd stake my badge on it. Break them.
